content:
Mindbloom 🧠


We’re on a mission to end America’s mental health crisis. Founded in 2018, Mindbloom is the #1 trusted brand in psychedelic therapy.

Today, we’re the first and largest national provider of ketamine therapy for depression, anxiety, and PTSD. Our product is the most clinically effective and premium client experience by far, all while being affordable to everyday Americans, 100% from the comfort and convenience of home.

Every day, we hear stories of transformation from clients like Leslie, “I suffered from crippling anxiety, depression, and became treatment-resistant. I tried Mindbloom out of literal desperation. Ketamine therapy has changed my life – perhaps even saved it”.

• 800,000+ sessions to date
• 39 states reaching 90% of Americans
• 3 largest peer-reviewed studies in psychedelic medicine history

Tomorrow, Mindbloom will offer the next generation of psychedelic medicines, including MDMA and psilocybin.

Do The Best Work Of Your Life ✨


The care teams you build are the care you deliver.

Mindbloom is an intense, mission-obsessed, and fun environment. We might take our work a little too seriously, but never ourselves. Clients come first, and we hold a high bar for talent and performance. If you’re looking to play on Easy mode, this is not for you. All Bloomineers are voracious learners, fiercely committed to becoming the best in their craft. 

• Our Founder and CEO, Dylan Beynon, is a 3X founder building world-positive companies (1 exit and 2 healthcare category leaders with hundreds of millions raised)
• Our Medical Director, Dr. Leonardo Vando, is a pioneer in psychedelic therapy
• Our seasoned leadership team hails from household-name startups

We’re backed by Tier 1 investors, including Kleiner Perkins, 8VC, and Founders Fund.

Thrive In A Conscious Company Culture 🧘🏽‍♀️🧘‍♀


We don’t just transform our clients’ lives – we transform our Bloomineers’ lives too, through a culture of freedom and responsibility. 

• Remote-first from founding
• Asynchronous-oriented
• Rigorous and writing-based

Our CEO won the Tony Hsieh Award for building an innovative and transformational culture, and we’re consistently honored in employer awards like LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. 

Our Core Values:


• Practice Intellectual Honesty: You seek and speak the truth directly and possess high courage and low ego
• Make Exceptional Decisions: You use the case-appropriate level of rigor, data, and speed
• Cultivate Wholeness: You bring your authentic self and practice positivity
• Focus: You simplify, practice deep work, and say no often

Role 🎨


As a Guide, you'll help people reclaim their lives, one client at a time, by supporting them from intention-setting to integration.

• Personalize each client’s healing journey with empathy, curiosity, and intention
• Lead treatment session prep and integration sessions through Zoom that help clients turn insights into lasting change
• Support clients in choosing integration practices that actually resonate and stick
• Build simple accountability systems to help new behaviors take root
• Act as a trusted liaison to our clinical and support team, answering questions with clarity and care
• Respond rapidly, communicate clearly, and remove friction every step of the way
• Contribute to the development and growth of the guide program

Sound Like You? 🎧


• Mission-Obsessed: You’ve experienced altered states of consciousness
• Experience: You have a track record of professionally coaching clients, cumulatively over 100 hours 
• Trusted Facilitator: You are capable of holding space for complex, challenging, and novel experiences with an open, non-directive, unbiased, and warm presence
• Webside Manner: You are thoughtful, compassionate, professional, and never keep a client waiting 
• Remote-able: You thrive in telehealth, with your inbox and Teams messages handled, documentation always on time, and never missing a beat on updates
• Tech Savvy: You can teach yourself new tools quickly and troubleshoot independently 
• World-Class: Fiercely committed to becoming the best at your craft, through science-based approaches and continuous learning
• AI-First: You harness AI to deliver better client outcomes, streamline admin, and stay at the cutting edge of coaching

Screening Process ✍


• Async Role Alignment
• Live Evals

Benefits 🤝


• Freedom: Remote work and set your own schedule
• Insurance: Malpractice insurance covered
• Admin: Minimal admin work (but paid) 
• Psychedelic Therapy: 90% off Mindbloom for you and 40% off for your family

The hourly rate for this role as an independent contractor starts at $22 USD.

Do The Best Work Of Your Life ✨


The care teams you build are the care you deliver.

Clients come first, and we hold a high bar for clinical excellence. You'll be surrounded by a team that helps each other grow. We might take our work a little too seriously, but never ourselves. 

• Our Founder and CEO, Dylan Beynon, is a 3X founder building world-positive companies (1 exit and 2 healthcare category leaders with hundreds of millions raised)
• Our Medical Director, Dr. Leonardo Vando, is a pioneer in psychedelic therapy
• Our seasoned leadership team hails from household-name startups

We’re backed by Tier 1 investors, including Kleiner Perkins, 8VC, and Founders Fund. 

Thrive In A Conscious Company Culture 🧘🏽‍♀️🧘‍♀


We don’t just transform our clients’ lives – we transform our Bloomineers’ lives too, through a culture of freedom and responsibility. 

• Remote-first from founding
• Asynchronous-oriented
• Rigorous and writing-based

Our CEO won the Tony Hsieh Award for building an innovative and transformational culture, and we’re consistently honored in employer awards like LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. 

Our Core Values:


• Practice Intellectual Honesty: You seek and speak the truth directly and possess high courage and low ego
• Make Exceptional Decisions: You use the case-appropriate level of rigor, data, and speed
• Cultivate Wholeness: You bring your authentic self and practice positivity
• Focus: You simplify, practice deep work, and say no often

Role 🎨


As a Clinician, you'll help people reclaim their lives, one client at a time, through expert evaluation, personalized treatment, and care that adapts as they progress.

• Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations over video to understand each client's needs and whether Mindbloom is the right fit
• Educate clients on the science, safety, and the experience itself, turning anxiety into informed confidence
• Prescribe ketamine therapy using our clinical protocols as your foundation and your clinical judgment to tailor treatment to each client for the best outcomes 
• Partner with Mindbloom guides to give each client a coordinated, whole-person experience
• Provide an exceptional client experience that earns their trust, their satisfaction, and their confidence in the care you deliver
• Improve our clinical protocols and care model with insights from your work with clients

Sound Like You? 🎧


• State Licensure: Psychiatric-Mental Health NP (new grads welcome) or Psychiatric PA (minimum 6 months of psychiatric experience)
• Experience: You confidently take on complex psychiatric evaluations and accurately diagnose depression, anxiety, and PTSD
• Mission-Obsessed: You’re a passionate believer in psychedelic therapy 
• Webside Manner: You're warm, professional, and fully present on every video consult, and you never keep a patient waiting 
• Tech Savvy: You can teach yourself new tools quickly and troubleshoot independently 
• World-Class: You're fiercely committed to clinical excellence, always advancing your expertise, and open to new evidence-based treatments
• AI-First: You harness AI to deliver better client outcomes, streamline admin, and stay at the cutting edge of psychiatric care

Interview Process ✍


• Recruiter Phone Screen
• Clinical Interview
• Reference Calls

Benefits 🤝


• Freedom: Remote work and set your own schedule (pick the hours you work Monday-Sunday)!
• Collaborators: We provide collaborating psychiatrists (in states where applicable)
• Licensure: We help cross-license you and cover the costs
• Balance: 60-min initial intakes and 30-min follow-ups
• Appointments: Paid no-shows and cancellations within 24 hours
• Learning: Bi-weekly lunch & learn with our medical director
• Insurance: Malpractice insurance covered
• Admin: Minimal admin work (but paid)
• Psychedelic Therapy: 90% off Mindbloom for you and 40% off for your family

The estimated annual compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $180,000 USD (based on 40 hours / week). The actual total annual compensation may differ based on your current level of job-related skills and experience, location, licensure, and market data changes. Consult with your Recruiter during any potential screening to determine a more targeted range based on the job-related factors. We don’t ever want the pay range to act as a deterrent from you applying.

States: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming

Mindbloom 🧠


We’re on a mission to end America’s mental health crisis. Founded in 2018, Mindbloom is the #1 trusted brand in psychedelic therapy. 

Today, we’re the first and largest national provider of ketamine therapy for depression, anxiety, and PTSD. Our product is the most clinically effective and premium client experience by far, all while being affordable to everyday Americans, 100% from the comfort and convenience of home.

Every day, we hear stories of transformation from clients like Leslie, “I suffered from crippling anxiety, depression, and became treatment-resistant. I tried Mindbloom out of literal desperation. Ketamine therapy has changed my life – perhaps even saved it”. 

• 300,000+ sessions per year
• 39 states reaching 90% of Americans
• 3 largest peer-reviewed studies in psychedelic medicine history

Tomorrow, Mindbloom will offer the next generation of psychedelic medicines, including MDMA and psilocybin.

Do The Best Work Of Your Life ✨


The care teams you build are the care you deliver.

• Our Founder and CEO, Dylan Beynon, is a 3X founder building world-positive companies (1 exit and 2 healthcare category leaders with hundreds of millions raised)
• Our Medical Director, Dr. Leonardo Vando, is a pioneer in psychedelic therapy
• Our seasoned leadership team hails from household-name startups

You’ll join a network of nationally renowned medical advisors that hail from Johns Hopkins, Weill Cornell Medicine, MAPS, Mount Sinai, and Houston Methodist Hospital. 

Clients come first, and we hold a high bar for clinical excellence. 

• PTSD: 92% reported symptom improvement
• Anxiety & Depression: 89% reported symptom improvement
• Safety: 95% reported no side effects across 800K+ sessions

Role 🎨


As a Collaborating Psychiatrist, you’ll literally transform and save lives by elevating our clinicians through mentorship and upholding world-class protocols. 

• Serve as the collaborating psychiatrist (supervising physician) for Mindbloom’s PMHNPs and Psych PAs, helping them deliver their best care to every client
• Review and approve clinician audits and reports on your own time; our team does the prep, so you focus on your clinical judgment
• Lead periodic case reviews over video to trade insights on complex cases while our clinical leadership fields the day-to-day questions

Sound Like You? 🎧


• Licensure: Board-certified psychiatrist in good standing
• Highly Collaborative: You bring a true partnership mindset, meeting clinicians as colleagues and collaborating with leadership to improve client outcomes
• Remote-able: You excel in telehealth, showing up on time for scheduled meetings and staying responsive between touchpoints
• Mission-Obsessed: You’re a passionate believer in psychedelic therapy 

States: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming

content:
Mindbloom 🧠


We’re on a mission to end America’s mental health crisis. Founded in 2018, Mindbloom is the #1 trusted brand in psychedelic therapy.

Today, we’re the first and largest national provider of ketamine therapy for depression, anxiety, and PTSD. Our product is the most clinically effective and premium client experience by far, all while being affordable to everyday Americans, 100% from the comfort and convenience of home.

Every day, we hear stories of transformation from clients like Leslie, “I suffered from crippling anxiety, depression, and became treatment-resistant. I tried Mindbloom out of literal desperation. Ketamine therapy has changed my life – perhaps even saved it”. 

• 800,000+ sessions to date
• 39 states reaching 90% of Americans
• 3 largest peer-reviewed studies in psychedelic medicine history

Tomorrow, Mindbloom will offer the next generation of psychedelic medicines, including MDMA and psilocybin.

Do The Best Work Of Your Life ✨


The care teams you build are the care you deliver.

Clients come first, and we hold a high bar for clinical excellence. You'll be surrounded by a team that helps each other grow. We might take our work a little too seriously, but never ourselves. 

• Our Founder and CEO, Dylan Beynon, is a 3X founder building world-positive companies (1 exit and 2 healthcare category leaders with hundreds of millions raised)
• Our Medical Director, Dr. Leonardo Vando, is a pioneer in psychedelic therapy
• Our seasoned leadership team hails from household-name startups

We’re backed by Tier 1 investors, including Kleiner Perkins, 8VC, and Founders Fund. 

Thrive In A Conscious Company Culture 🧘🏽‍♀️🧘‍♀


We don’t just transform our clients’ lives – we transform our Bloomineers’ lives too, through a culture of freedom and responsibility. 

• Remote-first from founding
• Asynchronous-oriented
• Rigorous and writing-based

Our CEO won the Tony Hsieh Award for building an innovative and transformational culture, and we’re consistently honored in employer awards like LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. 

Our Core Values:


• Practice Intellectual Honesty: You seek and speak the truth directly and possess high courage and low ego
• Make Exceptional Decisions: You use the case-appropriate level of rigor, data, and speed
• Cultivate Wholeness: You bring your authentic self and practice positivity
• Focus: You simplify, practice deep work, and say no often

Role 🎨


As a Clinician, you'll help people reclaim their lives, one client at a time, through expert evaluation, personalized treatment, and care that adapts as they progress.

• Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations over video to understand each client's needs and whether Mindbloom is the right fit
• Educate clients on the science, safety, and the experience itself, turning anxiety into informed confidence
• Prescribe ketamine therapy using our clinical protocols as your foundation and your clinical judgment to tailor treatment to each client for the best outcomes 
• Partner with Mindbloom guides to give each client a coordinated, whole-person experience
• Provide an exceptional client experience that earns their trust, their satisfaction, and their confidence in the care you deliver
• Improve our clinical protocols and care model with insights from your work with clients

Sound Like You? 🎧


• State Licensure: Psychiatric-Mental Health NP (minimum 6 months of psychiatric experience) licensed in Missouri with an active DEA registration 
• Experience: You confidently take on complex psychiatric evaluations and accurately diagnose depression, anxiety, and PTSD
• Mission-Obsessed: You’re a passionate believer in psychedelic therapy 
• Webside Manner: You're warm, professional, and fully present on every video consult, and you never keep a patient waiting 
• Tech Savvy: You can teach yourself new tools quickly and troubleshoot independently 
• World-Class: You're fiercely committed to clinical excellence, always advancing your expertise, and open to new evidence-based treatments
• AI-First: You harness AI to deliver better client outcomes, streamline admin, and stay at the cutting edge of psychiatric care

Interview Process ✍


• Recruiter Phone Screen
• Clinical Interview
• Reference Calls

Benefits 🤝


• Freedom: Remote work and set your own schedule (pick the hours you work Monday-Sunday)!
• Collaborators: We provide collaborating psychiatrists (in states where applicable)
• Licensure: We help cross-license you and cover the costs
• Balance: 60-min initial intakes and 30-min follow-ups
• Appointments: Paid no-shows and cancellations within 24 hours
• Learning: Bi-weekly lunch & learn with our medical director
• Insurance: Malpractice insurance covered
• Admin: Minimal admin work (but paid)
• Psychedelic Therapy: 90% off Mindbloom for you and 40% off for your family

The estimated annual compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $180,000 USD (based on 40 hours / week). The actual total annual compensation may differ based on your current level of job-related skills and experience, location, licensure, and market data changes. Consult with your Recruiter during any potential screening to determine a more targeted range based on the job-related factors. We don’t ever want the pay range to act as a deterrent from you applying.
